Good to know

Before you book

Straight answers to the questions every customer asks before booking.

How much will it cost?

Most visits start at from $65 (sample starting price — the final price is confirmed before any work begins). You approve the price first; what you approve is what you pay.

How long will it take?

Most visits run 30–60 minutes; bigger jobs take longer and get a written time estimate up front. Every service lists its time on this page.

What if I'm not happy with the result?

Tell us straight away and we'll make it right — re-do, adjust, or talk it through until you're satisfied. If we can't fix it, we'll say so honestly.

What happens at my first visit?

We listen first: what you need, what you've tried, what matters most. Then we agree a plan and a price with you before anything starts.
